thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (prod-us-east-1). p95 and p99 latency up. Pager triggered to @eric.oncall and ops.

eric.oncall: getting alerts. looking at grafana — p95 jumped from ~400ms to 5.2s in the last 2m, p99 at ~9.6s, 5xx from 0.4% -> 7.8%. any recent deploys?

sam: yep there was a deploy 3m ago — rollout id: rollout-2026-03-15T17:23:11Z (service: inference-gateway). can confirm spike aligns with that time.

jordan: i'm on the deploy. we changed the connection pool defaults + enabled multiplex zero-copy patch in runtime. rolling change across 4 pods.

maya: seeing gateway queue depth growing on those pods, connection stalls and many upstream timeouts (504). KV cache miss rate also spiking (evictions up).

eric.oncall: are error traces pointing to downstream model servers or gateway?

sam: traces show requests reaching runtime but stalling on first token generation — stack shows flush waiting on kv-cache-lookup for some sequences. p50 tok gen fine, p95/p99 blow.

jordan: hmm that matches the zero-copy path we shipped — possible race with the new async-kv loader. i'm rolling back that patch on one canary pod now.

sam: can you patch the canary and confirm? maya, can you reroute 10% traffic to healthy pool?

maya: changing route: `redwood route set-weight /v1/generate production=90 canary=10` — applying.

ops-bot: deployment rollback suggested by incident policy because p99 > 2s and error rate > 5% for 2 consecutive minutes.

eric.oncall: @jordan please do immediate rollback if canary shows same behavior. otherwise we start full rollback. also notify support.

jordan: starting rollback for runtime patch on canary pod (host: inf-runtime-7). command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-gateway --to-revision=202603151712` — executing.

sam: i'm watching metrics. can we also lower concurrency on gateway to reduce head-of-line blocking while rollback completes? `kubectl set env deploy/gateway MAX_CONNS=200`

maya: applied concurrency cap on gateway. also temporarily raised autoscaler target to 6 -> 12 to absorb bursts.

liz.cs: cs here — we have customers pinging about timeouts. I'll post a status note on status.redwood.ai: "We are seeing elevated timeouts for some generation requests in US-EAST. Engineers are investigating; mitigation in progress."

eric.oncall: good. Sam, any quick mitigation we can do if rollback is slow? e.g., route to smaller model variant or enable prefetched KV caching?

sam: could route low-latency customers to model-x-small variant (lower quality) as temporary fallback. command: `redwood route model-override set /v1/generate customer=beta model=model-x-small` — takes effect in ~30s.

jordan: canary rollback complete on pod inf-runtime-7 — canary looks good: p95 back at ~420ms, p99 780ms, errors down.

maya: i'm shifting weights back to production=100 canary=0.

ops-bot: rollback verified by ops-bot. metric checks passing.

eric.oncall: rolling back fleet to previous revision now. `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-gateway --to-revision=202603151712 --namespace=prod` — this will be a coordinated revert across nodes, expect ~3–5m.

jordan: initiating fleet rollback. deploy-bot: comment?

deploy-bot: Rollback started for inference-gateway (revision 202603151712). Started by jordan at 1768904390.

sam: post-rollback telemetry: p95 480ms -> 430ms, p99 900ms -> 820ms, 5xx back down to 0.6%. errors trending down.

eric.oncall: great. customer impact? liz.cs?

liz.cs: updated status: mitigation in progress, reduced impact after rollback. opened ticket for top 10 affected customers and assigned to kate from CS.

maya: note: KV-cache miss spike likely due to eviction policy combined with zero-copy patch. we'll need a deeper dive — possible ordering bug in async loader.

jordan: ack. i'll revert zero-copy branch and open a bug: runtime/async-kv/#742. adding detailed logs.

sam: action items during postmortem: 1) revert and run synthetic loadtest for kv-heavy prompts 2) add canary healthcheck for kv miss rate and first-token latency 3) add automatic model-override fallback for high-latency windows 4) tighten deploy policy to gate zero-copy on kv telemetry.

eric.oncall: i'll file incident and do SEV-2 template. include timeline, root-cause hypothesis, rollback commands, customer impact summary, and next steps.

ops-bot: incident closed: rollback successful, metrics stabilized, 35m total from first alert to stabilization.

jordan: adding notes: "Root cause: race condition in async-kv loader triggered by zero-copy buffer path -> elevated kv-cache evictions -> token-gen stalls for long contexts."

liz.cs: CS will follow up with affected customers and offer credits where appropriate.

eric.oncall: thanks all. we'll schedule postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT. assign owners: jordan (runtime fix), sam (telemetry/gating), maya (routing/autoscale runbooks), liz.cs (customer comms).

sam: thumbs up. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
